scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build rust/wasm --target bundler --out-dir pkg && bun install
scripts.test:web: bun run wasm:test && cd apps/web && bun test
scripts.build:web: bun run wasm && cd apps/web && bun run build
scripts.dev:wasm: cargo watch -w rust/crates -w rust/wasm/src -s 'wasm-pack build rust/wasm --target bundler --out-dir pkg && bun install'
scripts.dev:web: bun run wasm && turbo run dev --filter=@bluper/web
scripts.check:desktop: bun run wasm && cd apps/desktop && bunx tauri build --no-bundle && BLUPER_SELFTEST=1 ../../target/release/bluper-desktop
scripts.publish:wasm: bun run build:wasm && npm publish rust/wasm/pkg --access public
